name: Happify (Twill)
short_description: Evidence-based digital mental health platform using positive psychology and CBT, now part of DarioHealth's integrated chronic condition management ecosystem.
long_description: Happify (now Twill, part of DarioHealth) is a digital mental health platform built on the science of positive psychology, CBT, and mindfulness. The platform delivers gamified activities and tracks designed by scientists to help users build resilience, reduce stress, and overcome negative thinking. Backed by 30+ peer-reviewed studies, Happify has demonstrated significant reductions in depression and anxiety symptoms. In 2022, Happify Health rebranded to Twill, expanding to offer a comprehensive behavioral health platform addressing mental health alongside chronic physical conditions like diabetes, hypertension, and musculoskeletal pain. DarioHealth acquired Twill in 2023, integrating mental health into their digital chronic condition management platform. The combined platform serves enterprise customers including employers, health plans, and pharmaceutical partners with whole-person health solutions.
one_liner: Positive psychology-based mental health platform, now integrated with DarioHealth chronic care.
